title: quick-fix american naan bread wrap
description: A fun twist on the classic wrap, featuring marinated chicken, melted cheese, and crispy veggies in a toasted naan bread. This flexitarian-friendly dish is perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together the marinade ingredients.
Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 10 minutes, or up to 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Grill the naan bread for 1-2 minutes, or until crispy and lightly charred.
Spread a tablespoon of olive oil on each piece of naan bread.
Add a piece of chicken to each piece of naan bread, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese, sliced red onion, sliced bell peppers, and chopped cilantro.
Fold the naan bread in half to enclose the filling.
Grill the wrap for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Serve hot, with hot sauce on the side if desired.
If desired, top with additional cheese, sour cream, or other toppings.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
